name: Family Disputes
overview: Scripture acknowledges that family disputes are a reality, as Jesus Himself foretold conflict even among close relatives (Matthew 10:35). However, believers are called to pursue peace and brotherly love, addressing offenses privately to restore relationships (Matthew 18:15; Romans 12:10). Rather than seeking personal revenge, Christians are reminded to leave judgment to the Lord, recognizing that all will stand before Christ’s judgment seat (Romans 12:19; Romans 14:10). Ultimately, the Bible teaches a balance between acknowledging inevitable tensions and responding with grace rooted in God’s justice and love.
